description: Donor/recipient immunogenetic compatibility under two published rule sets: HLA-B leader match (-21 M/T, Petersdorf 2020) for a single HLA-B mismatch, and KIR ligand (C1/C2/Bw4) class comparison, computed over each side's full typing QC. Rule checking against published frameworks; it does not rank or recommend a donor. recipient/donor: {"A": [...], "B": [...], "C": [...], "DRB1": [...], ...} (allele strings only, no patient identifiers). Decision support only; not a medical device.

donor.description: locus -> up to 4 reported allele names. Allele strings only: never patient names, medical record numbers, dates of birth, or accession or case identifiers.

recipient.description: locus -> up to 4 reported allele names. Allele strings only: never patient names, medical record numbers, dates of birth, or accession or case identifiers.

name: donor_compat

b_mismatches.description: HLA-B mismatch count; null when B is missing, over-typed or unresolvable on either side.

donor.description: Donor HLA-B leader genotype; null when B is not typed.

leader_match.description: Set only for exactly one HLA-B mismatch with a known M/T leader on both mismatched alleles; otherwise null (not assessable).

recipient.description: Recipient HLA-B leader genotype, e.g. M/T; null when B is not typed.

donor_valid.description: Donor typing QC had no errors.

code.description: unresolvable, deprecated_name, locus_mismatch, null_allele, too_many_alleles, single_allele, homozygous, drb345_unexpected or drb345_not_reported.

severity.description: Any error makes the typing invalid.

code.description: unresolvable, deprecated_name, locus_mismatch, null_allele, too_many_alleles, single_allele, homozygous, drb345_unexpected or drb345_not_reported.

severity.description: Any error makes the typing invalid.

recipient.description: KIR ligand classes present (C1, C2, Bw4).

status.description: Treat missing_in_* as provisional unless complete.

recipient_valid.description: Recipient typing QC had no errors.

release.description: IPD-IMGT/HLA release every verdict was computed against.
